about.title: About me
about.lead: I'm HIRWA Aime JOSPIN — also known as MC HAJ — a Full-Stack Developer based in Rusizi, Rwanda.
points: I enjoy problem solving, creativity and innovation, and I care about building software products I'm proud to put my name on.
My goal is to build many creative software products, keep broadening my skills, and grow my computer and multimedia skills.
I'm comfortable working independently and as part of a team.
I'm looking for a job or an internship, freelance clients, and collaborators who care about quality.
